headline.purpose: Section titles in the ledger column.

title.purpose: Step names, card labels, component headings.

lede.purpose: Hero supporting paragraph and section ledes, in Muted Ink.

body.purpose: Step descriptions and prose, capped near 60ch.

caption.purpose: Table headers, example captions, chip labels.

mono.purpose: Commands, paths, identifiers, versions, and score numbers only.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Every entrance in the load sequence and state settles.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Timeline events arriving: the started row at 0ms, the comment at 900ms.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: The relay rail drawing downward at 250ms.

motion.name: fill
motion.value: 400ms ease-out-expo, from Hairline to Landing Green
motion.purpose: Score pips filling one by one after the comment lands.

motion.name: wait
motion.purpose: The started dot blinking while the review is in flight, then settling.

motion.name: copy-confirm
motion.purpose: Copy button turning Landing Green after a successful copy.

components.name: Copy Button
components.description: Copies the install command; turns Landing Green when the copy lands.
components.css: .ds-btn-copy { width: 5.25rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262b4a); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 300ms, background-color 300ms, border-color 300ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-copy:hover { background: var(--color-raised, #1b1f38); border-color: var(--color-muted, #9398ba); } .ds-btn-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-relay, #38d3f6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-copy--copied, .ds-btn-copy--copied:hover { color: var(--color-go, #3deb8e); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-go, #3deb8e) 50%, transparent); background: transparent; }

components.name: OS Tabs
components.description: Platform switch in the install panel header.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262b4a); } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #9398ba); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--color-raised, #1b1f38); color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-relay, #38d3f6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Install Panel
components.description: The primary action: OS tabs over one copyable command row.
components.html: $ curl -fsSL https://downloads.reviewrelay.dev/install.sh | bash
components.css: .ds-install { background: var(--color-surface, #14172b); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262b4a); border-radius: 12px; max-width: 38rem; } .ds-install__row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; } .ds-install__cmd { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; white-space: nowrap; font: 400 12.5px/1.6 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); } .ds-install__prompt { color: var(--color-muted, #9398ba); user-select: none; } .ds-install__copy { width: 5.25rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262b4a); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 14px/20px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-install__copy:hover { background: var(--color-raised, #1b1f38); border-color: var(--color-muted, #9398ba); }

components.name: Command Block
components.description: Multi-line terminal commands with unselectable prompts.
components.html: $ review-relay start$ review-relay status
components.css: .ds-cmd { margin: 0; background: var(--color-surface, #14172b); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262b4a); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; overflow-x: auto; font: 400 13.5px/1.625 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); } .ds-cmd__line { display: block; } .ds-cmd__prompt { color: var(--color-muted, #9398ba); user-select: none; }

components.name: Finding Chip
components.description: Severity label on a review finding.
components.css: .ds-chip-finding { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-flag, #b3a6f7) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 6px; color: var(--color-flag, #b3a6f7); font: 500 12px/18px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Comment Card
components.description: The scored review comment; the only card on a canvas.
components.css: .ds-comment { background: var(--color-surface, #14172b); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262b4a); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); max-width: 27rem; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-comment__head { padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #262b4a); font-size: 14px; } .ds-comment__head span { color: var(--color-muted, #9398ba); } .ds-comment__body { padding: 16px; } .ds-comment__score { margin: 0; font-size: 41.6px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--color-go, #3deb8e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-comment__score span { font-size: 24px; color: var(--color-muted, #9398ba); } .ds-comment__label { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Signature PR-timeline rail: dots carry the signal of their event.
components.html:
Greptile Review started

review-relay commented
components.css: .ds-timeline { position: relative; padding-left: 28px; font: 500 14px/20px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #eceef8); } .ds-timeline__rail { position: absolute; left: 5px; top: 10px; bottom: 12px; width: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-relay, #38d3f6) 60%, transparent); } .ds-timeline__event { position: relative; margin: 0 0 20px; } .ds-timeline__dot { position: absolute; left: -28px; top: 4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-relay, #38d3f6); } .ds-timeline__dot--go { background: var(--color-go, #3deb8e); }

narrative.overview:
review-relay does its work while the author is somewhere else: a review starts on GitHub, the agents they chose read the code, and a verdict appears on the pull request. The system is the calm, dark workspace that work happens in. Surfaces are quiet tonal layers of one deep blue-black, type is set plainly, and nothing glows at rest. Light is an event. A cyan signal means something is in flight; green means something landed; lavender means a finding wants attention. When a page uses color, a reader should be able to say what happened.

Density is moderate and left-aligned. Content reads like a ledger: a heading and one-line lede on the left, the substance on the right, separated from the next ledger by a single hairline. The signature is the timeline rail borrowed from a PR's own event history, a vertical line with dots, used for the sample review and for the steps of a review.

The page plays one moment on load: the review starts, the relay line draws, the scored comment lands. Everything else is still.
keyCharacteristics: One dark ground with two tonal steps; depth by tone and hairline, never by shadow, blur, or glow.
Three signal colors, each with one meaning; no decorative color anywhere.
A single sans family at every level; monospace only for code, paths, versions, and numbers.
The PR timeline rail as the recurring structural motif.
One orchestrated load sequence; motion otherwise only answers a user's action.

rules.name: The Something-Landed Rule
rules.body: Green appears only where a verdict exists or an action completed. If nothing landed, nothing is green.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each signal color has exactly one meaning across the product. A color used for decoration teaches the reader to ignore it.

rules.name: The Typed Text Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks text a person would type, copy, or read from a terminal. It is never a costume for looking technical.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Sections never center a headline over a grid of cards. Heading and lede on the left, content on the right.

rules.name: The Lights-Off Rule
rules.body: At rest nothing casts light: no shadow, no blur, no glow. Declare elevation once, as tone plus hairline.

rules.name: The One Card Rule
rules.body: Cards never nest. A figure on the page is a canvas, not a card; only the comment inside it is a card.

dos: Do use Landing Green (#3deb8e) only for verdicts and completed actions.
Do separate surfaces with a tonal step and a 1px Hairline (#262b4a).
Do set code, paths, versions, and score numbers in JetBrains Mono with tabular numbers.
Do label illustrative content as an example, as the sample review's caption does.
Do keep the load sequence the only unprompted motion, and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't add box shadows, backdrop blur, glows, or gradient text.
Don't nest cards or turn sections into grids of same-size cards.
Don't color hovers, bullets, or icons green or cyan for decoration.
Don't put eyebrow labels or tracked capitals above headings.
Don't tile the dot grid across the page; it belongs behind the sample review only.
